final: SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) as line_item_count, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_product_cost > 0 THEN CAST(ili.derived_total_cost AS FLOAT) / CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10
